brief_description: Transform static images into dynamic videos with AI-powered motion generation.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: URL of the source image to be animated. The image will be automatically uploaded to PixVerse servers.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Text prompt describing the desired motion or action in the video (e.g., 'the boy and girl running along the beach').

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds.

parameters.name: negative_prompt
parameters.description: Negative prompt to specify what you don't want in the video (e.g., 'blurry, low quality').

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducible results. Set to 0 for random generation.

parameters.name: sound_effect_switch
parameters.description: Enable automatic sound effect generation for the video.

parameters.name: sound_effect_content
parameters.description: Sound effect content to generate. If not provided, a sound effect will be automatically generated based on the video content.

parameters.name: lip_sync_tts_switch
parameters.description: Enable lip-sync with text-to-speech for characters in the video.

parameters.name: lip_sync_tts_content
parameters.description: ~140 (UTF-8) characters. If the generated audio exceeds the video duration, it will be truncated.

parameters.name: lip_sync_tts_speaker_id
parameters.description: Speaker ID for the TTS voice. Only used when lip_sync_tts_switch is enabled.
